newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Cbank repo average yield falls to 16.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Cbank repo average yield falls to 16.74 pct.

text.p: The average yield at a Slovak central bank (NBS) three-day repo tender on Monday fell to 16.74 percent from 18.82 percent on Monday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered a maximum amount of 2.0 billion crowns. Overall bids totalled 2.655 billion crowns. The minimum accepted yield was 14.00 percent with the maximum yield hitting 19.00 percent.
The NBS added 7.0 billion crowns through a one-week repo tender on Monday, with the average yield falling to 18.82 percent from 19.83 percent in a similar repo on Friday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 21 lacked 3.32 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
